title: Assemble portable architecture reading artifacts
description: Prepare a self-contained offline reading artifact from qualified semantic views and explicitly selected explanatory content without publishing it.
inputs: Qualified projections, selected source detail and exact generator/renderer/resource identity.
Private output candidate location and declared reading profile.
outputs: Complete candidate HTML, diagrams, reading resources and content manifest.
Explicit generation failure or missing-resource diagnostics.
behavior: Embed the selected engineering definitions, rationale and source identity needed for understanding; optional external references remain distinguishable from included content.
Produce readable keyboard-accessible overview/detail navigation and preserve qualification and gaps in all five views.
Treat model content as data, escape text and constrain links; reject executable content or external resource dependencies in rendered output.

Use bundled reading resources and deterministic content identity independent of incidental wall-clock observations; no network, source checkout, generator or model database is required to read the completed output.
Validate the complete candidate inventory before handing it to the separate publication responsibility.

failure_behavior.condition: Rendering fails or required resources are absent or unsafe.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report incomplete preparation and do not replace existing readable output.

failure_behavior.condition: An optional source link cannot be followed offline.
failure_behavior.outcome: Retain required included explanation and show the optional link limitation.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
